text:
Anna L: quick proposal — fragmented streaming mirror for air-gapped model bundles. sign once (manifest+index), ship small seed + fragments, allow resumable fragment pulls and verifier-only operator mode. goal: shrink initial transfer and make resume robust. :spiral_notepad:

Mike K: sounds promising. how do we prove fragments are valid without downloading full blob?

Anna L: index is a signed merkle manifest with per-frag hash and byte-range. operator can verify each fragment against manifest as it arrives. only manifest needs signer trust chain.

Jess R: risk: agent needs incremental apply semantics and disk layout for partial files. also what about dedupe if mirror sends duplicate frags?

Anna L: agreed. plan: write fragments to staging dir as distinct files, maintain a chunk-tracking DB (simple sqlite). apply step concatenates + validates final root hash. dedupe by hash before write.

Theo P: what about CAB/ops UX? we need a simple CLI for recover/resume and a verify-only dry run.

Anna L: example CLI usage:```
rdw-mirror fetch --manifest /media/usb/manifest.json --staging /var/lib/redwood/staging --resume
rdw-verify manifest verify --staging /var/lib/redwood/staging --mode verify-only
```

Mike K: can we support streaming from airgap proxies that only provide fragments (no manifest)?

Anna L: proxy-only mode: proxy returns a signed index header first, then fragments. fallback if header missing: fetch seed that contains trimmed index and fall back to full-bundle path.

Jess R: performance tradeoffs? small fragments => more seeks and metadata ops. large fragments => longer resume windows. we should pick ~8–64MB range based on observed USB read patterns. :thinking: 

Anna L: agreed, default 32MB. implement adaptive fragment size heuristics based on device throughput during probe phase.

Theo P: security: signer rotation, revocation, key escrow. how do we do safe rollback gating?

Anna L: manifest includes activation window + previous-root chain. agent enforces activation window and optional operator override with audit log. revocation via CRL-like signed revocation list that is fetched (offline CRL delivered with seed or via admin portal).

Mike K: what about dedup across models? we should support content-addressed storage so identical shards can be hardlinked. saves disk on multi-model installs.

Anna L: yes — store by content-hash under modelstore/objects and reference from manifest. add GC marker during apply.

Jess R: can we get a quick PoC milestone?

Anna L: propose: week1: manifest format + signer tool; week2: fetcher + staging + sqlite tracker; week3: verify/apply and operator CLI. small canary with 1.5B model in test lab.

deploy-bot: artifact:rdw-mirror: new branch pushed: feature/frag-mirror + tests (CI queued). :thumbsup:

Theo P: docs note — clearly call out constraints: no partial inference until full apply, disk space for staging, and admin approval step for activation. also include troubleshooting playbook for "stuck resume".

Mike K: +1 on playbook. one more ask: include metrics we can expose to Console: frag-pulled-count, resume-attempts, verify-failures, apply-duration.

Anna L: will add metrics and dashboard mocks. ok to start RFC writeup based on this thread?

Jess R: yes, I'll help with operator flows and failure modes section.

Anna L: thanks all — will draft RFC and drop here early tomorrow. :)
